"""Regression test for cx_001: customer must be refused access to the admin export endpoint."""

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
import pytest

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("minishop_app_under_test", Path(__file__).parent / "app.py")
assert _spec is not None and _spec.loader is not None
minishop = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(minishop)


@pytest.fixture
async def client():
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=minishop.create_app())
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://minishop") as c:
        yield c


async def test_admin_export_forbidden_for_customer(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    """A customer actor must receive 403 when calling GET /admin/export."""
    # Sign up and log in as a customer
    signup = await client.post("/auth/signup", json={"email": "cx001@x.io", "password": "pw-cx001"})
    assert signup.status_code == 200

    login = await client.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "cx001@x.io", "password": "pw-cx001"})
    assert login.status_code == 200
    token = login.json()["token"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # Customer attempts to access the admin export endpoint — must be refused
    r = await client.get("/admin/export", headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 403
